a.lede: Micro Center has reclassified Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090 graphics cards as 'Not Carried,' and almost all units are out of stock at its stores.
a.title: Nvidia RTX 5090 disappears from Micro Center amid rumors of a production halt

b.lede: Nvidia states that RTX 5090 isn't discontinued, only that supply is constrained — and yet the card is effectively gone from storefronts
b.title: Nvidia reportedly insists the RTX 5090 isn't dead despite severe shortages and removed listings at multiple retailers
